source_findings.finding: Both modes initialize the durable card and overlay at virtual address2. Legacy does not intentionally disable VMU emulation.
Legacy skips the New-only SDK SCI route, timeline and read-ahead binding; selected low callbacks remain reader-specific.

Boot checking scans both subunits of the selected controller port. Table0x8c202768 maps bothA1/A2 thenB1/B2 andremainingports. Connection acceptance requires the SDK memory-function connection check plus the filesystem readiness byte in its per-unit record; absence of a ready/mounted card can produce the warning without proving no Maple discovery.

A raw-reader forwarded interrupt can retain a pending return depth until the SDK handler returns through rehook. The trampoline preserves interrupted SPC/SGR and consumes the pending return before testing whether to reinstall the reader.

VMU SD loan refuses BUSY before I/O if GD work, reader IRQ work, pending raw return depth or receiver activity prevents borrowing. Quiet idle ordinarily unhooks, so pending return depth is not an established permanent Legacy failure.
An unacquired BUSY storage loan is mapped to a retry response. Card INFO and MEDIA replies themselves do not need an SD loan.
